CONTROLS.NAME: pulser_on
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Creates pulses emanating from the center. Moves on BPM with the option bpm pulse, or manually with the button manual pulse.

CONTROLS.NAME: bpm_pulse
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Pulses every two beats, based on bpm.

CONTROLS.NAME: manual_pulse
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: bpm pulse should be set to OFF to use this. Manually create a pulse on press.

CONTROLS.NAME: beat_flasher_on
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Flashes the whole screen when a beat is detected if set to on.

CONTROLS.NAME: bpm_flasher_on
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Turns the screen into a BPM strobe effect when set to on.

CONTROLS.NAME: painter_on
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Turns the screen into a BPM strobe effect when set to on.

CONTROLS.NAME: auto_painter
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: When set to on, pushes the brush around the screen in time to the music. Disable this to manually control the painter.

CONTROLS.NAME: paint_pulse
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Pulse the size of the brush on button press.

CONTROLS.NAME: manual_painter
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: auto painter MUST BE SET TO OFF. Manually move the brush around the screen by using the pad.

CONTROLS.NAME: brush_size
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Change the size of the circular paintbrush by moving this slider.

CONTROLS.NAME: feedback
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Add motion blur to everything in the scene. Higher is more blur.

CONTROLS.NAME: noise_on
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Add a white noise/grain effect to everything in the scene.

CONTROLS.NAME: invert
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Change from white on black to black on white.

CONTROLS.NAME: brightness
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Change brightness of the output. With feedback this can get overdriven to complete whiteout.
